title: Prabhas' Spirit Moves to Diwali 2027, Sets Up Ramayana Clash
excerpt: Sandeep Reddy Vanga announced October 29, 2027 with a new poster, moving the Prabhas-Triptii Dimri cop drama from March and into the Diwali window alongside Ramayana Part 2.
body:
• Prabhas and director Sandeep Reddy Vanga's cop drama Spirit will now release worldwide on October 29, 2027, in the Diwali window, moving from March 5, 2027.
  • Vanga announced the new date on October 18 with a fresh poster showing Prabhas in a black cap, sunglasses and a full beard.
  • The shift sets up a potential Diwali clash with Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 2, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi.
  • For diaspora fans, Spirit is planned as a multilingual pan-India release, with Prabhas playing an IPS officer alongside Triptii Dimri and Vivek Oberoi.

Prabhas' next big-screen outing has a new date. Spirit, directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga, will release in theatres worldwide on October 29, 2027, coinciding with Diwali, according to Bollywood Hungama. The film was earlier scheduled for March 5, 2027.

Vanga announced the change on October 18 with a new poster. Filmfare reported the poster caption as, "Prabhas Anna's new poster. Shades on. Spirit always," and quoted Vanga's post marking October 29 as the Diwali 2027 worldwide release date. No official reason for the move was given in the reports.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=qtpoHTdj948

"Filmfare reported the poster caption as, "Prabhas Anna's new poster."

What the Film Is

Spirit is the first collaboration between Prabhas and Vanga, the filmmaker behind Arjun Reddy, Kabir Singh and Animal. Prabhas plays a police officer — described in reports as a hot-headed IPS officer, and by Variety India as a former IPS officer who finds himself in prison, with Prakash Raj reportedly playing a jailer. Character details beyond that remain under wraps.

https://x.com/Filmyscoopss/status/2111797838955094196

The cast includes Triptii Dimri as the female lead, Vivek Oberoi — reported as the antagonist — and Aishwarya Desai, with Kanchana also in the ensemble, according to Bollywood Hungama and Variety India. The film is written and directed by Vanga and produced by Bhushan Kumar, Pranay Reddy Vanga, Krishan Kumar and Prabhakar Reddy Vanga, for T-Series and Bhadrakali Pictures.

The project was first announced on October 23, 2025, on Prabhas' birthday, with a sound-story teaser titled "One Bad Habit." Its first-look poster followed on January 1, 2026, showing Prabhas with long hair and visible injuries. The new poster is different in tone: a stark close-up, thick beard, black sunglasses and a black baseball cap, with the cap's shadow covering much of his face.

Why the Date Matters

Diwali is the most contested release window in Indian cinema, and Prabhas has rarely used it. Filmfare noted that his earlier pan-India releases — the Baahubali films, Saaho, Radhe Shyam, Adipurush, Salaar and Kalki 2898 AD — arrived in summer, monsoon or Christmas windows rather than Diwali. Moving Spirit there is therefore a deliberate claim on the festival audience, not a routine delay.

Filmfare also linked the March vacancy to Prabhas' other film, Fauzi, a period war drama that moved from December 2026 to March 2027. With Fauzi taking the spring slot, Spirit was free to move to the autumn. The two films, arriving about seven months apart, give Prabhas two very different releases in 2027 — a historical drama first, then a contemporary cop action film.

A Potential Clash With Ramayana Part 2

The new date puts Spirit in the same festive corridor as Ramayana Part 2, directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. Bollywood Hungama described it as a potential clash whose extent will depend on the final schedules of both films. Reports differ on whether Ramayana Part 2 shares the exact date or follows within days, so a head-to-head opening is not yet confirmed.

The connection between the two camps is close. Ranbir Kapoor starred in Vanga's Animal, opposite Triptii Dimri, who now leads Spirit opposite Prabhas. Vivek Oberoi is reported to appear in both Spirit and Ramayana Part 2. That overlap is why trade watchers expect negotiation before either side locks into a direct collision for screens.

What It Means for Diaspora Audiences

For Indian audiences in the United States, Canada, the Gulf and Australia, a Diwali release is practical as well as festive: it lands on a holiday weekend when family theatrical outings are already planned. Spirit is planned in multiple languages, which matters for diaspora theatres that program Telugu, Hindi and Tamil versions in the same multiplex. Readers planning around it should note the exact date — October 29, 2027 — and expect advance booking for the Diwali weekend to open through their local chains closer to release.

What to Watch Next

Production is expected to be completed by mid-2027, according to Filmfare. The next signals to watch are a teaser with footage rather than posters, confirmation of the exact Ramayana Part 2 date, and whether either production shifts again to avoid splitting the Diwali audience. For now, the date is set, the poster is out, and Diwali 2027 has its first major contest.
